caption: The drawing shows a semicircular decorative collar set against a solid dark background. The collar is rendered in shades of pale blue and white, with detailed lace-like patterns. The outer edge of the collar is trimmed with a scalloped border, and within the collar, there are repeated motifs of flowers, leaves, and geometric shapes arranged symmetrically. Small dots and intricate lines fill the space between the larger motifs. The name "E. MILLER" appears in the lower right corner in small, white capital letters. The material of the collar is illustrated to appear delicate and textured, contrasting with the smooth, flat background.
title: Embroidered Linen Collar
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
